l0_mlp = data["L0_MLP"]  # (5, 10, 4)
l1_mlp = data["L1_MLP"]
l2_mlp = data["L2_MLP"]
W_U = W["unembed.W_U"]  # (4, 6)

seqs = [
    [-9, 4, 13, -1, -5, -8, 13, 5, -9],
    [10, 3, 7, -5, -5, 8, 5, -12, -8],
    [9, 1, 11, 11, -6, 12, 12, 0, -1],
    [-14, 12, 5, -15, -4, 10, 6, 13, -4],
    [8, -13, 6, 5, -14, 8, -4, 14, -10],
]

# Collect per-category writes
below_l0, above_l0, inrng_l0 = [], [], []
below_l1, above_l1, inrng_l1 = [], [], []
below_l2, above_l2, inrng_l2 = [], [], []

for b in range(5):
    for p in range(9):
        pos = p+1; inp = seqs[b][p]
        if inp < 2:
            below_l0.append(l0_mlp[b,pos]); below_l1.append(l1_mlp[b,pos]); below_l2.append(l2_mlp[b,pos])
        elif inp > 7:
            above_l0.append(l0_mlp[b,pos]); above_l1.append(l1_mlp[b,pos]); above_l2.append(l2_mlp[b,pos])
        else:
            inrng_l0.append(l0_mlp[b,pos]); inrng_l1.append(l1_mlp[b,pos]); inrng_l2.append(l2_mlp[b,pos])

BL0,AL0,RL0 = np.stack(below_l0),np.stack(above_l0),np.stack(inrng_l0)
BL1,AL1,RL1 = np.stack(below_l1),np.stack(above_l1),np.stack(inrng_l1)
BL2,AL2,RL2 = np.stack(below_l2),np.stack(above_l2),np.stack(inrng_l2)

print("Max std within category (indicator→low, mapper→high):")
print(f"       | below | above | inrng")
for name,B,A,R in [("L0_MLP",BL0,AL0,RL0),("L1_MLP",BL1,AL1,RL1),("L2_MLP",BL2,AL2,RL2)]:
    print(f"{name} | {np.std(B,axis=0).max():.4f} | {np.std(A,axis=0).max():.4f} | {np.std(R,axis=0).max():.4f}")

# Logit-effect votes per value
print("\nLogit votes: inp | exp | L0→ | L1→ | L2→")
expected = [[2,4,7,2,2,2,7,5,2],[7,3,7,2,2,7,5,2,2],[7,2,7,7,2,7,7,2,2],[2,7,5,2,2,7,6,7,2],[7,2,6,5,2,7,2,7,2]]
entries = {}
for b in range(5):
    for p in range(9):
        pos=p+1; inp=seqs[b][p]; exp=expected[b][p]
        v0=np.argmax(l0_mlp[b,pos]@W_U)+2
        v1=np.argmax(l1_mlp[b,pos]@W_U)+2
        v2=np.argmax(l2_mlp[b,pos]@W_U)+2
        if inp not in entries: entries[inp]=[]
        entries[inp].append((exp,v0,v1,v2))
for inp in sorted(entries.keys()):
    exp=entries[inp][0][0]
    cat="B" if inp<2 else ("A" if inp>7 else "R")
    v0s=sorted(set(e[1] for e in entries[inp]))
    v1s=sorted(set(e[2] for e in entries[inp]))
    v2s=sorted(set(e[3] for e in entries[inp]))
    print(f"{inp:4d}{cat} exp={exp}: L0→{v0s} L1→{v1s} L2→{v2s}")
